what: The label gate's check for the labels the pages show from recordings: the demonstration sighting's labelled faces and the vault's 24 recorded searches, each face read by the server's DESCRIBE POLE (backend/larql_vault.py inspect_bipolar_slot). Layers count from 0 (page layer = layer + 1).

lens.name: J++
lens.caution: Fitted on the base model, not on the model it reads: compare its readings between matched sightings; do not take its words as this model's own. Layers count from 0 here (the pages count from 1). The order of conditions it gives was checked against the model's behaviour from layer 20; at layers 20-29 trust only that order; below layer 20 the study's two checks disagreed, so treat even comparisons there as unconfirmed. Use layers 30-49 for condition contrasts. At layers 50-58 this lens reads 'she' at or above a woman persona for 6-7 of the 9 AI personas the study tried: flag pronoun readouts there unless a lens fitted on the instruct model agrees. Neuron-pole word labels predicted causal effects only at the sampled layers 40-57; they were at chance at 10-30, and 31-39 were not sampled. It was fitted on positions 16-127 (counting from 0) of 128-piece passages and the study checked it only on short texts (at most 141 word-pieces in its fidelity check), so how well it reads further in is unmeasured; from position 1024 on, 50 of the model's 60 layers no longer look back to the start of the text.

label_gate.measure: word-piece ids in both readings' first ten, fp32, softcapped
label_gate.cut: none of ten: the instrument's choice; the study set no threshold
label_gate.validated: the count used as a graded score, not the cut: AUC 0.84 within layers 40-57 (counting from 0), for base-fitted J++ labels on random neurons
label_gate.caution: The words are still sent: held_back marks the labels the instrument's pages leave out of their main reading, and they keep them in the apparatus. A label is held back below layer 40 (reason below_layer_40), and, under the base-fitted J++ lens (jpp-base) below layer 59, where its two readings share none of their first ten word-pieces (reason shares_nothing). Under any other lens the agreement gate is unvalidated (erratum E47): only the layer holds a label back, and shared_top10 is a count, not a verdict (lens_validated false). A neuron edited in the vault is read through its edit (edited true, lens_validated false); the gate was never measured on edited neurons, but under jpp-base the cut still holds back an edited label that shares none. A neuron whose write vector is zero (silenced in the vault by DELETE) writes nothing: every word-piece ties, so it has no count (shared_top10 null) and is held back (reason writes_nothing). Below layer 40 shared_top10 depends on how ties at the softcap break, so it may differ from the study's count there; the hold-back there rests on the layer alone. At layer 59 the lens is the identity, so the two readings are one and always share ten.
